none: PAS NLM-86AF18: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Aby with Greenfield
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constans (337-350), issue of 347-348, Reece Period 17. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Reverse description: Two victories facing each other each holding wreath. Reverse inscription: VIC[TORIAE DD AVGG QNN]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.37mm, Weight: 1.19gms, Die axis: 6
